description:
Title: Storage management

First, the order is read from the automatic order management system.
Then, it's checked if the first product from the order is in stock.
If it's in stock then it's withdrawn from the warehouse.
However, if it's not in stock then it's reordered from the wholesaler.
Note, that if it was necessary to wait more then 10 days for the arrival of the  product then a delivery delay penalty is automatically demanded from the wholesaler.
After the ordered product has arrived it's registered in the stock management system.
Finally, it's checked if the whole order is ready for shipment.
If the order is ready for shipment, a courier is requested and the products are packed simultaneously and finally shipped.
If it isn't then the next product from the order is selected and the process starts again with checking if this order is in stock or not.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_StorageManagement" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_StorageManagement" name="Storage management"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFirstProduct" name="Select first product from order"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductMerge" name="Product to check">
      <bpmn:documentation>Exclusive merge: the first product or the next product enters the stock check. Only one incoming path is active at a time.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check whether product is in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockSplit" name="Product in stock?" default="Flow_StockNo"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Withdraw" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Reorder" name="Reorder product from wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrived" name="Ordered product arrived"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DelaySplit" name="Waited more than 10 days?" default="Flow_NoDelay"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty from wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DelayMerge" name="Delay assessed">
      <bpmn:documentation>Exclusive merge: either the penalty was demanded or no penalty was due. Only one incoming path is active.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReadyMerge" name="Product stock settled">
      <bpmn:documentation>Exclusive merge: products withdrawn from the warehouse and products registered after reorder both lead to the order readiness check. Only one incoming path is active per product.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReady" name="Check whether whole order is ready for shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReadySplit" name="Order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_OrderNotReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipParallelSplit" name="Start courier request and packing"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipParallelJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipOrder" name="Ship order"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderShipped" name="Order shipped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_StorageManagement" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_SelectFirstProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_SelectFirstProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_Withdraw">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${inStock}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_StockSplit" targetRef="Task_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_Withdraw" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_Reorder" targetRef="Event_ProductArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrived" targetRef="Gateway_DelaySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_DelaySplit" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${waitingDays > 10}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDelay" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_DelaySplit" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ReadyMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadyMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_CheckReady" targetRef="Gateway_ReadySplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadySplit" targetRef="Gateway_ShipParallelSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${orderReady}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderNotReady" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ReadySplit" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_ShipOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderShipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
